name: quantdinger
description: AI trading research and strategy backtesting for US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, ETFs, and crypto. Turn ideas into strategies, compare returns and drawdowns, and monitor positions in QuantDinger.

interface.shortDescription: Research markets. Build strategies. Backtest with trading costs.
interface.longDescription:
Turn a trading idea into a strategy you can test. Research US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, ETFs and crypto in your Codex conversation.

Describe your rules, build strategy code, and run a historical backtest with fees and slippage. Compare returns, drawdowns and completed trades; save the result and reopen it in QuantDinger.

Connect your own QuantDinger account to inspect positions, fills and pending orders. Supported trading actions require your explicit confirmation and account permissions. See the repository for Windows and macOS installation. Hosted operations may consume credits; historical results do not guarantee future performance.
defaultPrompt: Backtest an NVDA MA20/MA60 strategy over 90 days, including fees.
Analyze Tencent (0700.HK) over 90 days: trend, volume, and risks.
Compare BTC moving-average and RSI strategies over 90 days.
